notes.title: Light de deux on Fall in Love Visual Novel Festival
notes.content: [p]Hi! Today is the beginning of Fall in Love Visual Novel Festival a Steam festival centered on romance-themed stories. The festival will go for the next week, from September 24th-October 1st.[/p][p]We are participating in the festival. To celebrate the festival, we've set a 50% discount.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098846/0c9d6bdfbee7d24a7f60769ce1eeccbc0afe0bc9.png"][/img][/p]
